title: PR #42578 — Market filter modal design validation

ac1-assert-title-filter.expression: (function(){ var headers = document.querySelectorAll('.mm-modal-content h5, .mm-modal-content h6, .mm-modal-content [class*="modal-header"] p, .mm-modal-content header p'); var title = ''; headers.forEach(function(h){ if (h.textContent.trim()) title = h.textContent.trim(); }); if (!title) { var allText = document.querySelector('.mm-modal-content')?.querySelector('header, [class*="header"]'); title = allText ? allText.textContent.trim().split('\n')[0].trim() : ''; } return JSON.stringify({ title: title }); })()

ac2-assert-sort-by-header.expression: (function(){ var modal = document.querySelector('.mm-modal-content'); if (!modal) return JSON.stringify({ hasSortBy: false }); var texts = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('p, span')).map(function(el){ return el.textContent.trim().toUpperCase(); }); return JSON.stringify({ hasSortBy: texts.includes('SORT BY') }); })()

ac3-assert-rank-header.expression: (function(){ var modal = document.querySelector('.mm-modal-content'); if (!modal) return JSON.stringify({ hasRank: false }); var texts = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('p, span')).map(function(el){ return el.textContent.trim().toUpperCase(); }); return JSON.stringify({ hasRank: texts.includes('RANK') }); })()

ac4-assert-border-separator.expression: (function(){ var lastField = document.querySelector('[data-testid="sort-field-option-fundingRate"]'); if (!lastField) return JSON.stringify({ hasBorder: false }); var style = window.getComputedStyle(lastField); var hasBorder = style.borderBottomWidth !== '0px' && style.borderBottomStyle !== 'none'; return JSON.stringify({ hasBorder: hasBorder }); })()

ac5-assert-selected-bg.expression: (function(){ var selected = document.querySelector('[data-testid="sort-field-option-volume"]'); if (!selected) return JSON.stringify({ hasBgHover: false, hasCheck: false }); var hasBgHover = selected.className.split(' ').some(function(c){ return c === 'bg-hover'; }); var hasCheck = !!selected.querySelector('svg'); return JSON.stringify({ hasBgHover: hasBgHover, hasCheck: hasCheck }); })()

ac5-screenshot-sort-modal.note: AC1-5: Filter modal with headers, border, grey selected bg

ac5-assert-new-selection-bg.expression: (function(){ var prev = document.querySelector('[data-testid="sort-field-option-volume"]'); var curr = document.querySelector('[data-testid="sort-field-option-priceChange"]'); function hasDirectBgHover(el){ return el.className.split(' ').some(function(c){ return c === 'bg-hover'; }); } return JSON.stringify({ prevHasBg: prev ? hasDirectBgHover(prev) : null, currHasBg: curr ? hasDirectBgHover(curr) : null, currHasCheck: curr ? !!curr.querySelector('svg') : false }); })()

ac5-screenshot-selection-change.note: AC5: Selection changes grey bg and checkmark to new item

ac6-assert-filter-selected-bg.expression: (function(){ var selected = document.querySelector('[data-testid="filter-select-option-all"]'); if (!selected) return JSON.stringify({ hasBgHover: false }); var hasBgHover = selected.className.split(' ').some(function(c){ return c === 'bg-hover'; }); return JSON.stringify({ hasBgHover: hasBgHover, ariaSelected: selected.getAttribute('aria-selected') }); })()

ac6-assert-unselected-text-default.expression: (function(){ var opt = document.querySelector('[data-testid="filter-select-option-crypto"]'); if (!opt) return JSON.stringify({ colorsMatch: false }); var textEl = opt.querySelector('p, span'); var textColor = textEl ? window.getComputedStyle(textEl).color : ''; var selectedOpt = document.querySelector('[data-testid="filter-select-option-all"] p, [data-testid="filter-select-option-all"] span'); var selectedColor = selectedOpt ? window.getComputedStyle(selectedOpt).color : ''; return JSON.stringify({ textColor: textColor, selectedTextColor: selectedColor, colorsMatch: textColor === selectedColor }); })()

ac6-screenshot-filter-dropdown.note: AC6: Filter dropdown grey bg on selected, default text color
